description: This file defines a mock class 'TestModuleMock' for unit testing, which inherits from 'firebolt::rialto::TestModule'. It uses Google Mock to create mock methods for testing IPC module interactions, including methods for handling protobuf-based RPC calls and generating response objects.

classes.name: TestModuleMock
classes.description: A mock class for 'firebolt::rialto::TestModule' used in unit testing IPC interactions.

methods.name: TestRequestSingleVar
methods.description: Mock method for handling a single variable test request.

methods.name: TestRequestMultiVar
methods.description: Mock method for handling a multi-variable test request.

methods.name: TestResponseSingleVar
methods.description: Mock method for handling a single variable response.

methods.name: TestResponseMultiVar
methods.description: Mock method for handling a multi-variable response.

methods.name: TestRequestSingleVarNoReply
methods.description: Mock method for handling a request with no reply.

methods.name: defaultReturn
methods.description: Simulates a successful RPC call by invoking 'done->Run()'.

methods.name: failureReturn
methods.description: Simulates a failed RPC call by setting controller failure and invoking 'done->Run()'.

methods.name: getSingleVarResponse
methods.description: Creates and returns a 'TestSingleVar' protobuf message with specified 'var1' value.

methods.name: getMultiVarResponse
methods.description: Creates and returns a 'TestMultiVar' protobuf message with specified fields.
